name: AmberX listeners
author: Brett
description: Every AmberX device's background listeners in the Dev Console (listener@1): the hands-free wake word, the command after it, the Speak button, Gizmo's talk mode, the recorder mic, the axHub watch, the veto alarm and the page's own listeners, with their live state (listening, paused for a call or another app, stopped on errors with the reason, who holds the microphone, the last error) as each phone publishes it to the hub (amberx-axf/_data/listeners/devices), and the per-listener controls (allowed, pause for calls, pause for other apps, start sound, restarts before it gives up, Restart) written to the AmberX settings document on the hub so every phone follows. Apps → AmberX → Listeners; REST /api/plugins/amberx-listeners (devices, policies, registry, state, policy, restart), MCP amberx-listeners_*, CLI listeners.mjs / axf amberx-listeners.

keeps: /projects/amberx-axf/_data/listeners/devices on axHub: what the phones publish (the AmberX Listeners plugin writes it)
/projects/_shared/_data/settings/apps/amberx-droid.json: the AmberX settings document the policies live in (AmberX's own)
